text:
While the Florida heat (and current COVID restrictions)  may keep me from visiting Key West, I can experience a slice of it here locally in Bristol borough.  Such a delightful little place!  Thanks to COVID 19 entering the yellow phase and the "al fresco" dining that it has "inspired" we found ourselves checking out this sweet little cafe in the heart of Bristol borough, Cindy's Cafe.  A family owned and run establishment with a small yet tasty menu.  We came for breakfast and sat in glorious weather at a cute umbrella covered table.  Sounds of island music just loud enough to hear yet not overwhelming gave just that little touch of ambiance that perfected the breeze and the morning sun.  

When owners take initiative and care about their business it shows and Kelly was no exception sitting with us making us feel at home and giving us a little info on the place.  Her pride and commitment to Cindy's is unmistakable as it should be because this place is the epitome of what a family run business should be. 

The food was well cooked and enjoyable, the portions adequate and the prices fair.  The modifications made for COVID-19 were on point. If aching to dine out after this chaos, check out Cindy's as you will not be disappointed. We are excited to go back and try some of the unique lunch options.
Order seaweed salad but got a squid salad. Ordered chicken pad Thai.. got beef pad Thai. Extremely disappointing. Ordered sashimi Dinner and got nigiri .

Let me start by saying I took my parents here 3 weeks ago for an early Saturday dinner and the food/service FANTASTIC. I was so excited about it that I decided to take my boyfriend for a Saturday evening dinner. 

1. Seating - Started by having to ask the bartender after being seated for 30 min to please get water, utensils and to take our order. The main server straight up ignored our table after having made eye contact multiple times. We were sitting directly across from the bar/kitchen access. 

2. Drinks - my lemon drop was missing the triple sec... so not only was it just vodka and lemon, it had ice in it (???) and was missing the sugar rim. After mentioning it to the main server, he patronizingly apologized in an over-the-top, sarcastic manner. The bartender also came over to apologize, but in the same manner--they were literally mocking me. I was so embarrassed. 

3. Food - our appetizer was forgotten, even after we confirmed it twice with the server. When we mentioned it was forgotten, the third server rolled her eyes and acted as if it was a burden that we still wanted it. I had the same burger that I had a few weeks ago with my parents and it couldn't have been more different. The patty was half the size and burned on all edges. The buns were dry. Super disappointing. 

4. Misc - the main server was probably wearing his mask correctly for a total of 10min that we were there (we were there for over an hour). He actually pulled his mask DOWN to talk to us. Pretty sure

Awesome breakfast and the customer service was exceptional. Asked for crispy bacon and potatoes and that's exactly what I got. 

I would definitely recommend breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

restaurant has a great vibe, food and the nicest owners.

support local small businesses, this place rocks.

Always wanted to try this place and never got around to it. A friend of mine recommended it and I said why not last week. I ordered the general tsos chicken pizza and LOVED it, Idk what Mei does to that chicken but oh my it's delicious! Girlfriend got noodles and soup and those two were delicious. Came back yesterday and got the kimchi pizza and it was delicious. You can't beat the price for the pizza and Mei is super cool. She's got a customer for life!
Excellent food with plenty of options. Great atmosphere and awesome staff. This is my favorite Mexican spot in the area. Highly recommend.
My wife is from Mexico! She loves the food here. Tiny place. All original mexican food.

At very busy time in their work day, Kelsey patiently answered my questions AND had a delicious lunch of JPI tuna salad and veggies ready for me as a take out when I arrived. Their tuna salad is my favorite among the many great selections on their menu. This business continues to be one of the best run places in Indi. Their staff never disappoints.

When you've gone through two days of moving and are way to tired and lazy to make dinner, what is your go to take-out? For us, it was Chinese food from China Palace. My boyfriend was easily able to order appetizers and entrees for us to share from DoorDash. We decided to order: cream cheese wontons, Hot and sour soup, BBQ pork chow mein, orange peel chicken, side of white rice and wontons crisps (I put these on the soup). Personally I am not a huge fan of the side sauces, but according to my boyfriend they were good as well! 

Caution, the chicken comes with chilies  for the spice and flavor. Perfect for exactly that but DO NOT EAT THE CHILES unless you're ready to soak your tongue in ice cold water the rest of the night...and yes I personally made this mistake. Live and learn right? BBQ chow neon was good and always a favorite of mine in these dinners. I never would have thought to have BBQ pork combined with the noodles, but I was very pleasantly surprised. I loved the wontons because it had the most amount of cream cheese goodness than other wontons I've had in the past.  

You can't forget to have the fortune cookies at the end right? I remember growing up these were so fun to me and the perfect ending to your Chinese dinner. I was told that you break it open, eat one half, read the fortune, and then if you like the fortune then you eat the other half. Did anyone else grow up hearing this or is it just me?

Food has always been pretty good, service as well. Beer choices are decent and rotate which is nice. Inside the atmosphere is pretty nice and inviting. I have to say I don't really like the sign outside which is why I didn't stop in for so long but after a few visits I really do like it.

My first time eating fat man's kitchen. 
Small businesses went out. Good businesses. It is said with a sadden heart. this should not have survived. 
the poorest quality of food. DO NOT WASTE YOUR HARD EARNED MONEY. THIS PLACE SERVES SLUM FOOD.

My fiance and I just moved to Louisiana a couple of months ago. We love to try new places, but the Olive Branch has quickly become our GO-TO for date nights! We love to go on Wednesdays for their pasta deal (buy one get one half off) and to share the Spinach Dip appetizer. Y'all.. This dip is so. dang. good. 

That is also to say that since we've started coming here, we have not ordered one single thing that we haven't liked. Our all time favorites have been the Pasta Jambalaya, Chicken Parmigiana, Combination pizza and their Chicken Caesar wrap! 

Also, the customer service is amazing every time we come. That's always a huge plus!
Incredible flavorful food. The best Kabab I've ever had. Basmati rice is perfectly seasoned. The spices with oil on side is like nothing my taste buds have ever enjoyed.

My fiancé and I were sat down in a relatively empty restaurant and our waitress handed us menus. She disappeared and we were never attended to. Not so much as a glad of water. Instead, all the wait staff were chatting in the corner. We will never be returning to this location ever again.

First of all our server Anthony was the best.! Love it when the wait staff know the menu inside and out. Took my hubby here for Father's Day . I swear we had the best meals we've ever had in a local restaurant . The scallops were huge and seared just right, truffle Mac and cheese was so rich and delicious , I had the best Salmon I've ever had and it's wild , not farm raised, delicious warm bread on the table , our drinks were great and again Anthony knew what we'd probably like . I give this place 2 thumbs up for atmosphere , cleanliness , Nice waitstaff and the food is amazing ! Oh the banana foster butter cake for dessert was out of this world!

Really excited to see another locally owned business in this part of town! Baby's should make your list for all the things- Work meeting? Check. Date night? Check. Family in town? Check. 

All around it was a great experience- from easy parking, no wait for patio seating, a straightforward menu, and quick service, it was all spot on. 

The food was good. But unfortunately,  I didn't think it was anything special- especially for the price. However,
That may be able to be overlooked by many because of all the other wonderful features of this local joint! Was just hoping for a little bit more of a wow factor!

We ordered delivery to our nearby hotel on Elk St.
Delicious, Fast, Hot, Fresh!
XL 1/2 Hawaiian,  1/2 Pepperoni & Jalapeno (bountiful, full of toppings, cheesey, crispy handmade crust, impressive).
12 BBQ Wings (roasted w sauce on side).
Ravioli & Meatballs (unique & tasty).
Fettuccine Chicken Alfredo (creamy & flavorful).
Greek Salad (huge & fresh).
My wife & I were both eating & speaking at the same time saying how much we like this pizza better than our favorite local pizzeria back home....lol
We hope to see you again soon.

I wish I could give this restaurant more stars, but I'm going to leave it at 3, only because of the dish I ate, which were the huevo rancheros. The pancakes were delicious, the flight of bacon was amazing, my Bloody Mary was okay, but man, those huevo rancheros were the worst I've EVER had. I've tried different takes on them too, that wasn't it. Basically, I got 3 very greasy, COLD tortillas, topped with two eggs (I chose over medium), and a little corner of some random tomato sauce. I added hot sauce to try to salvage it, but there was no way. It was just plain gross. The beans looked good, but they had absolutely no flavor. I added salt and hot sauce, only because I was starving, but I ended up only eating a piece of the hash brown, with part of one of the extra cold tortillas I got on the side. It was SO disappointing. What I did eat if it was greasy and gross. If you go, I suggest you order anything but the huevo rancheros. 

I only ate a bite of the pancake, but if we decide to go back, THAT'S what I'm getting. Buttery and delicious. I have to add that it was quick service, the waitress was super sweet and friendly, and the service was awesome for a Saturday morning. The environment was very family oriented, which I loved, and the outside eating area was nice as well.
Great salad and thin crust pizza. Not a true Tomato pie, but very good! Good service; a friendly place

We ordered carry out over the weekend and found it all very bright and tasty.  Plenty of good vegetarian options as well.  Food was thankfully ready when we went to pick it up as promised.  Well done, Akar!

My wife, 2 year old and I tried this restaurant again for the second time in 2 months. The first time was the breakfast wasn't very good. My pancakes were rubbery because they over mixed the batter. The kitchen manager (Sabina) came over and brought a new pancake to try and yes that one was better. She was very kind and gracious to give us a coupon to come back and try the food again. Well we went back yesterday and had the exact same experience. My pancakes were absolutely terrible. Just looking at them you could tell they were over cooked, rubbery and a little cold. They were cold because it took a a very long time for our breakfast to come out. Our server, honestly I can't remember his name, was great. He noticed the food didn't look right, acknowledged the food took forever and it was nice enough to bring me a waffle just so I could eat something. I wasn't going to wait another 25-30 minutes for new pancakes. The thing that made this experience worse was the fact that no manager came over to acknowledge what had happened. I completely understand the restaurant was a little busy, but taking 2 minutes to visit a table who's food looked terrible and wasn't very happy is NOT GOOD CUSTOMER SERVICE. I'm not here for a free meal, I'm here so people understand this is not acceptable in the restaurant industry. The chances of my family and I going back to this location is slim to none.

A+++ 

Came here last night with a party of 4. We made a reservation. We love that they take ressys. It's a small spot so it's necessary. We at first were sitting in the front, but the waitress noticed that we were pretty cramped because it is byob and we had a couple bottles of wine and beer, so she brought us to the back room since it was more spacious! We truly tore it up. FYI if you have a large party, they can accommodate! The aesthetic and atmosphere is very cute here. 

The food is amazing! We got the house salad and the Hiro Inch of Heaven(?) SO delicious. 

The service was amazing. Once we were done our meals, they let us hang out and finish our drinks rather than rushing us out. 

Highly recommend. 

Cash only, though! They have an atm.

Food was cold, and my drink was not completely full. On top of that, the employee at the pick up window had a mask that wasn't completely covering her mouth, and her manager that was assisting her wasn't wearing a mask at all.
Just returned from Restaurant Week lunch at The Olde Bar!  Fabulous.  First time there.  Interesting selection, 3-course lunch which was great.  Exquisite food, good service.
This has become a favorite on Uber eats! Bowls are consistently delicious and tried a calzone today that didn't disappoint! Delicious! Thank you for the good food amd services!

Great little surprise. Small authentic Mexican restaurant with really good food. Not much to look at. But good food. Waitress was sweet and pretty and nice. We would definitely revisit. They were low on help this day, so I'd like to go back again and see the changes.
I ate here twice while on vacation and it was amazing! Even during Covid they have went above and beyond to make sure their customers are safe AND the food was excellent.
A ok noodle house. But in St. Louis you really can't find too many choices for noodles. I guess that's the reason it has very good reviews.

Recommended on a local Facebook group. Didn't know where to go for Christmas dinner, but wanted to be in the beach. Read the Yelp reviews which were not very positive, but we went nevertheless. So glad we did!!! Fun place located next door/ affiliated with the Holiday Inn. Large outdoor patio, but it was a clear albeit chilly day so we stayed inside.
Fun place with iguanas all over. Fabulous waitress (Destiny) who was helpful with food and drink recommendations. The strawberry/ pineapple mojito was superb with mulled fruit/chunky and generous amounts and delicious. I believe we ordered 3. The pina colada with mango and extra rum floater was tasty with coconut rim( stuck on via honey); two of those!!!
Shots of something were handed out prior to the sun setting, adding to the fun atmosphere!
Food: we decided on appetizers. We started with an iguana shaped pretzel complete with cheese dip: yummy! The grilled oysters were well prepared with the correct amount of cheese and butter. We also got the trio sampler: the fish spread was reminiscent of the whitefish I grew up, with the proper amount of smokiness. The grouper nuggets weren't overly fried. The coconut shrimp was also well cooked, but the accompanying dipping sauce was overwhelming and took away from the taste.
Still hungry, my BF ordered some garlic/ cream shrimp which looked incredible, but I couldn't eat another bite.
Bottom line: excellent service from Destiny, delicious food at reasonable prices; outstanding drinks and

First off not hibachi 100% , no tabletop to cook in front of you. Secondly service was terrible , we had a party of 6 (4 adults) two kids. Four plates of food came out and two people who ordered tempura were told few mins. After everyone all ate , there food arrived?! No apology and nothing to help out the check. Place was not busy but you could tell there understaffed and just don't care. Anyways I won't be going back. With are bill over 120$ due to 18% gratuities , I would have loved to have the service I paid for in the tip.

This restaurant is the bomb! It's is so fresh, healthy and delicious. Their pasole is so good and the huevos rancheros are delicious. They also have refreshing drinks with basil, mango and lime. They play good music and also give to charities around Tucson which is super nice and cool.

So far I'm not expressed . With less people in here there still forgetful . My husband had his taste buds for oysters and they had none .  Tyler went back to see if they had some but came back sad face and said none . And then one of the waitresses waited till our waiter came to bring me the salt and pepper shaker and then I told our waiter that the girl right there and we had made eye contact was suppose to get the salt and pepper for us a few minutes later she acted like she didn't see him bring it to us go figure our waiter is very on point with everything I order the filet miagion and it just didn't taste right usually it melts in my mouth but not this time so I'm sorry to say but I think the next time I get a steak . I'll get it at a steak house . But let's give kiddos to our waiter Tyler

This place is phenomenal! Love the food especially the soups here and their customer service is great. I also like that they have a little kids play room where my kids can go and play while we finish our food,there's a little screen for us to watch them and eat at the same time.

This is easily my favorite Indian restaurant in the St. Louis area. Everything I've ever tried is fresh and wonderfully seasoned. The samosas are much better than other restaurants I've tried as well. The staff is extremely friendly and always kind. Well worth a stop in.

Tucked away in the corner of the parking lot you will find a great place with a great view! Awesome selection of local draft beer. Extremely fresh seafood. You must order the drunken shrimp! Catch of the day is ever changing but you can't go wrong with an choice you make. Fish tacos are my husbands go-to and they are delicious here.

This is a great lunch spot, but bring the $$$$.  Everything is fresh.  They have great salads and egg dishes.   I love their smoked salmon.  
Teas are great.   My only beef is that coffee and lattes are served in wide-mouth cup, almost the size of the bowl.  I find the coffee then gets cold very quickly.  And for how expensive a cup of coffee is there, I would at least want it to stay hot.
Is a go to when I want Mexican Food. Everything has great flavor and is fresh. Salsa Bar has some great choices. Come in and give it a try. My favorite burrito is the Rajas Burrito.
The best brunch in St Louis....and im from Cincinnati!! Great service even better food! Chicken and waffles is the shhhhhh!! Omelet with salmon where they do that at?? The SHACK is where!!

Where do I begin. First, I'd highly recommend reservations because this place gets busy.  Secondly, simply put this restaurant was outstanding. The staff was friendly and informative.  We had done our research before visiting so my wife and I went in knowing what we wanted to order. After asking the servers recommendations we went in slightly different directs and we couldn't have been any happier.  For our appetizers we went with the renown cauliflower and duck confit.  I was admittedly skeptical on how good could cauliflower actually be(there are only so many ways to cook). But I was wrong, it was cooked perfectly just like many other restaurants. The difference was the side sauces. Dear lord, they bring cauliflower to life like I've never had before.  The duck confit was cooked exceptional, but again the sauces knocked it out of the world.  You'll get the trend by time I'm done this review.  For my wife and I entrees we had the venison and scallops.  The venison was cooked perfectly, but again the side flavors brought into the meal through sauces were amazing. I have eaten venison more times than I can count and this was the best.  The scallops my wife had melted in your mouth.  We've ordered them right off of boats and they weren't this good, a true testament to the chefs! Lastly we had a side of the crispy potato salad. This was probably the best I have ever had. The dressing is what really made the meal. The server referred to it as crack sauce. I believe it. We were ho
Oh my goodness!!!!! Visiting from Austin, Texas and these guys got it going on!!!!!! Wow!

We stopped in on our way back from New Orleans to Baton Rouge. I had heard they had Kastle/Krystal type burgers, and my husband loves those.  He said they were very good. Not to mention their donuts are to die for. Thanks for the speedy and friendly service!

Went for a post-workout brunch with a few friends on Sunday. Hearty and healthy brunch with lots of choices. I got the desayuno tacos with tofu which had great flavor and the $2 Bloody Mary- which was spicy and delicious. Lots of seating available outside. Highly recommend! We'll be back to eat all the calories we just lost during the workout.
A true go to spot when I need my spirits lifted. The food portions are appropriate, the service is friendly and fast.

I'm going to go with some of the worse food and service I've had in a long time. The cheese in the quesadillas was pretty much processed cheese. The salad bar was lack luster and the sirloin was tough and chewy.  I don't care how many coupons you send out, never again.
I lllooovvveeeddd this place. Popped in for the first time on St.Pats and the corned beef hash was so perfect. Service was fast, staff was friendly. This is the cutest diner. Can't wait to go back.
Spot on tostadas every time! Guac is magical. Always get take out and comes full with utensils and napkins and all the sauces!

Keeping things floating along during covid...don't miss their free, yes I said FREE breakfast each Sunday from 10:30-12:30.  Buy a few drinks (the Bloody Mary never disappoints) and tip your server well.  

Breakfast bar is served by mask servers. Features biscuits, gravy, bacon, sausage, fried/scrambled eggs, French toast, etc.

Once in a while, my Filipino genetics get a better hold on me more than I'd like, and a craving for fried pork belly or crispy chicken wings over take me. I apologize to my cardiologist.

Sometimes local Asian stores like this will be a two-fer, because you can grab what you need from the butcher's, but also get ridiculously cheap vegetables like baby bok choy that other gourmet supermarkets ("wegmans" "whole foods" cough cough) will charge you triple the price. 

I have fun in the housewares department.  There are things there I found familiar from my childhood (a giant rice dispenser anyone?) and it's always entertaining to peruse kitchen goods.

Every time I order from Bono's I feel the need to leave a review about the horrendous service, but then I eat the pizza and forget about it.  For real, 5 stars for the amazing pizza, they nearly ALWAYS screw something up.  Delivery time twice as long as they say; orders not even making it into the system so when you arrive for pickup you have to wait 30 minutes; frustrating phone calls with workers that are CLEARLY high; and more.  Today was even more frustrating.  They have a 2 for 1 Tuesday deal that we've done for delivery a number of times.  Ordered it today and the guy on the phone could only remember 1 out of every 10 words I said.  Finally got the order through.  Delivery guy shows up on time with one pizza.  He was confused.  Bono's called me 10 minutes later and told me they don't do the 2-for-1 on delivery.  "Fine, no biggie" I think, "I'll remember that next time I order, but I'm excited for my 2nd pizza to come back."  Guy on phone is clearly saying I don't get the 2nd pizza I ordered.  I asked if that was the case, and he rudely said "fine, what did you want."  I reminded him of my order, and he said "well it'll be like an hour."  I said "okay, but I hope you can understand my position."  He said "okay" and quickly hung up.  Bono's, your pizza is fantastic, don't change a thing.  But for pete's sake try even just a LITTLE harder to be better at customer service.  You'd make a killing.

Wow. Went to this spot after a convention after searching for lunch on yelp. This place is STELLAR. Cute little restaraunt on a corner. Parking was easy. It was a great day for outdoor seating. Immediately upon walking in, we were smacked with delicious smells. The menu looked great.

I got a turkey avocado sandwich and a side of breakfast potatoes. meal was under $15 and was so delicious. Best turkey sandwich ive ever had. the rest of my party all enjoyed their meals. Service was friendly and fast. And we got complementary soup with our food. Most definitely will be returning when in Reno. Highly suggest this place!

This is my favorite place to chill and eat at by far.. The food is always amazing .. The soups are to die for and the people are welcoming.  Keep up the great work guys in the kitchen.. To the owner , this place is going places.. With the right front of the house staff and the perfect kitchen cooks etc , your business will boom more and more and this will be a place my family will talk about and a tradition to come every week.. Excellent job!!
Took a group of 11, nothing special, gluten-free options were decent.  Salads were poor
Has roaches they don't speak English and the tables were dirty and nasty don't go your better off eating Taco Bell nasty place

DELICIOUS FOOD! Menu is simple, but really it's all you need. My only complaints are that there were no dipping sauces for the chicken tenders (I wanted honey mustard) and the drinks were out of the cooler - just bottles and cans. So obviously no free refills and it felt silly paying for water. Nonetheless, we will be back!

I've been to this spot 4 times now. The food is amazing although extremely overpriced for the neighborhood. The only reason I'm giving it 3 stars and not 5 is the service. This place is in serious need of a staff overhaul. You don't get greeted when you enter. You practically have to beg someone from the waitstaff to take an order or pay a tab (and this is when the place is empty when its full its 10 times worse). The food takes a long time to come out but it's delicious and kinda worth the wait lol. If they can work on minimizing their prices by at least 10-15% and hiring ATTENTIVE wait staff that understand when you ask for a box for your food while simultaneously pulling your credit card out that you are ready to pay your bill and leave, then you'll get 5 stars.

I wish I had a chance to write a good review about the goat as I have heard so many great things about it. My brother, his wife, and I went there today to celebrate my brothers birthday.... we even brought a cake. We were looking forward to this more than usual as it was to help take our minds off the recent and unexpected passing of their baby daughter. 
The hostess was very nice and seated us promptly to a table just to the side of the hostess stand. As we watched the other tables be waited on again and again, we saw us being passed by. My sister-in-law finally got up to ask the host about a waitress, then we sat there for a few more minutes watching waitresses standing at the host stand, we got up to leave frustrated and upset.  As we walked out all they had to say was "we're sorry". But they will never understand how sorry we are that they did not get to celebrate not only my brother's birthday with us but also the celebration of my niece becoming an angel.

This is a 5/5 place for sure. Great food, meals were only $8-15. Awesome patio seating. The food was delicious and presented really well.

Everyone was so nice. It felt like I was simply visiting family and friends. 

Great place.

This is always our first stop when flying in to Tucson, and El Guero Canelo is near the airport. This family restaurant is now a recipient for one of the James Beard Awards. The ordering area has been enclosed since you order at the window, and come as you are. Picnic tables seat four, and there are plenty. Menu is limited. We like the quick Sonoran hotdog or Sammie (two weenies). A grilled pepper comes on the side. The tacos are the real deal. The guacamole is delicious. Several sauces are included. None are very hot and they're good. Sodas are in glass bottles just like old times. Try this place and become a regular.

I went tonight to celebrate my son's 13th B-Day and I was impressed after a while not going there I can tell this was the best outback I've ever been to, the food was Amazing  and the server was beyond excellent. I will recommend this to anyone that is looking for a good steakhouse

Long slow drive thru line. They made me pull up to wait on my order. I order 5 tenders 3 of them were so small. All my food was cold and old tasting! Why did I wait 5 minutes for cold and old food? Haven't been there in about 6 months. Guess I will not be coming back anytime soon.
Stopped in today for a burger and the recommendation was the bullseye burger - pretty good and HUGE- missing a burger set or it would have hit the spot

Had lunch with colleagues. Average food, service was below average - very slow and inattentive. Tables are too close, it so loud that you can't hear a waitress even though it wasn't crowded. Some items were out of stock, why then list them on regular menu?! We wanted to consider this place for a holiday party but will not return. I cannot recommend this place based on this experience.

My meal arrived without silverware, I was told to get it myself, my meal was missing half of what it said it came, because they ran out,  and charged me full price. I won't be back and I don't recommend coming here
Always a great experience. Love their fresh squeezed orange juice and their breakfast is great. Staff always friendly and attentive.

Go ahead, Greek it up.  We enjoyed our meal.  We always enjoy meals from sultry islands in the Med.  Healthy, too.  None of us are getting out of here alive, so grab that Santorini Sunrise or the Donkey's Kick Mojito and pass the tabbouleh.

Chicken is good, but I feel they should have more option, ie, purchase orders in increments of 5. 10,15 or 20 wings.   Also, would be nice if u could order all flats or all drum sticks, even if you pay a bit extra.

This place is severely infested with black mold. I feel for the employees.  If is so rancid in there that the napkins have the most awful musty stench. Avoid this place, if you value your health! Oh, and the food is absolutely disgusting!

Honestly, it was sadly one of the worst restaurants I've been to, and that is saying a lot since we visit and are always looking for something new. We decided to give it a shot because it was full, I will tell you that, but oh man, don't let it fool you. 
First, the chips were okay, crispy - but the salsa was rancid and tasteless at the same time. Then, we ordered a Guac as an appetizer - by the time the cart arrived to "make it" we already had our entrees on the table. We had a party of seven, and all ordered different and complex dishes but the food arrived in about 10-12 mins. THAT right there tells you a lot! Obviously it wasn't fresh, dishes were scalding hot, but the food was bland, tasteless. We rated the food around the table and on the range between 1-10 we all rated our dishes 1-4. I wanted to take out the bacon out of my nachos, and the server's response was that it was "already mixed in". Again, red flag on the freshness of the food. Taste was just awful and everybody feels like throwing up. So, if you want to try good mexican food, just skip it altogether

A fantastic meal for our family of 7. We were visiting Boise and have not been in a restaurant in 6 months so this was a great breakout.   3 of us had prime rib--cooked perfectly, and the rest of us had steaks.  Service was wonderful.
Great breakfast spot. Super nice staff. Food was good. We had an omelette and a Belgian waffle.

Outstanding!!! I'll be honest, my boyfreind and I are health freaks but we love a cheat day;especially, when it means burgers.... We pass this place every day and I have always wanted to go. I ordered the mango burger and my boyfreind ordered the the street burger. We are two picky individuals as we have been spoiled by having travelers tastes. Let me tell you. These burgers. Are worth. Traveling to. They were so juicy, perfectly cooked and large! Finally, the fries that came with were the icing on the cake.

Area is very clean, and they are taking strong precautions against COVID. They give you the food in your car which helps prevent any spread. 
Very friendly service! Because of finals, I picked up the food a little later and the owner offered to make a new one free of charge because it was no good. They seem to care about their food quality and customers. Very excited to try the lunch sweet and sour pork! Will send pictures and updated comments on the food.

Update: got the sweet and sour pork. Serving is pretty good for the price :)
My favorite place in indy to get a gyro by far the prices are good and the food is delicious. I'm definitely coming back quite a bit soon

Wow incredibly impressed with their sandwiches you will be too! They offer interesting and classic sandwiches. Check it out if your looking for a quick delicious lunch! I always take it to go and they prep it pretty quick and fresh

Celebrated Valentine's Day for the first time here! They had a special for two for $80 that included, two drinks, an appetizer or two side salads, two entrees and one dessert. Lemme tell ya, it was a ton of food! Everything was delicious and our food came out super hot so you knew it was fresh. The drinks we started with were a glass of wine and pomegranate martini.  Both were wonderful. The calamari was fantastic and their marina was a great dipping sauce for them. I ordered the salmon Oscar as my main entree and the portion was massive! I maybe ate half of it because of how full I was from our starter (and the bread)! We finished with their butter cake which was moist but also had a little crunch around the edges. We easily have two more meals with all the leftovers we took home!

Their tables are very well socially distanced. The place is huge and people are only being sat every other table. The service was great and it's a very romantic spot for a date night or special event! They do a massive amount of take out based on the 20 parking spots that were full of cars waiting for their to go food so it must be quality take out!
Love the chargrilled oysters! Been coming here for years. The pecan cobbler with ice cream is delicious too so save room for dessert!

I have been in this place couple times and I loved every time. Great brazilian barbecue, the best caipirinha ever. I'm Brazilian and I know a good Brazilian barbecue and Churrasco is the best. Very friendly service. Super nice place. I highly recommend it.

A great experience my first night in Nashville. Kinsey Coppin was playing and she was a joy to listen to. My catfish dinner came late, but the staff explained the issue to me, so I wasn't upset. They got my food out to me quickly once they realized the issue. It was very busy, but everyone inside seemed to be served well and very content! I would go back!

Ups your pricing but can't fill the box? Cheap. Not worth my 10 dollars for a plate when Panda Express does better. Please update the menu prices because if you aren't too careful you may be paying for some other item! Altogether shady...

This quaint little coffee spot housed in Mid City and within a traditional shot gun house space, decked with hard wood floors does not disappoint! I love the owner who is always helpful and nice and I love the coffee even more. I can honestly say that a cup from this place will definitely satisfy that caffeine fix. Throw in a pastry and you've got a perfect start to your morning!

I moved to NY but I come to NJ every other weekend and get Thai son AT LEAST twice a visit. This is my absolute favorite place for pho mignon and a beef stirfry platter. I'm obsessed with pho but this is the only place I've seen with filet mignon steak in their pho. And it's cheap!!! I can't say enough about it and their staff is always friendly. They're often packed but there's always a table to sit.

My go-to spot in the area for Mexican food. Not the best Mexican food you'll have but its fairly priced and the quality is consistent. If you dine in, they serve free margaritas which hit the spot. 

Some of the protein options are amazing while others are just OK. Highly recommend any dish with the al pastor, carnitas, barbacoa or chicken tinga. All of these are done really well, have a bunch of flavor and are juicy. You can't go wrong if you get something with these in it. In my experience, the carne asada, grilled chicken and chorizo tend to be on the dry side but taste decent if you're set on one of those. 

If you want to switch it up from the more typical dishes, I definitely recommend their tortas. They are massive, flavorful and are served on a kaiser with a nice chipotle mayo spread. The Cubano is my absolute favorite. I was originally a little disappointed the first time I ordered this as I was expecting a traditional Cuban sandwich but that quickly changed after I had my first bite and its now one of my favorite items. 

Other dishes that are worth trying are the alambres and sopes. Both are great and are a nice change to the more common dishes.

Han dynasty far exceeded my expectations, from the moment we sat down our waiter was attentive and menu knowledgeable, we ordered the lamb it was phenomenal cooked to perfection in oyster sauce and onions and herbs the chili oil dumplings were equally as good the wonton chicken stock soup was one of the best I have had all year it's just done right broiled and simmered for 12 hours cooked slow. All of the food is fresh the portions are plentiful. I plan on coming back ASAP ! Next time I'll order some noodles with the pork. Every square foot of the place smells amazing.
Went for Godson's Birthday. EXCELLENT service from Ticheal! Did an excellent job was helpful and friendly.

Balboa: enjoyed the hints of pumpkin but the crust was a little too crispy for my liking, liked dipping it in the cucumber ranch my wings came with. Wished I had eaten it when it was hot 
Haymaker: cheese was nice and creamy with a good umami flavor, would get again
Wings: very saucy and paired really well with the cucumber ranch.
Come on a weekday night for faster service. They warm the slices for you in the oven after you order, so make sure to eat it then instead of waiting! Would come back again to try the cheesesteak.

This place is a hidden gem! Don't be deterred by the fence, located inside the KOA Campground Park this restaurant is delicious! Best Texas style BBQ and friendly warm staff. Jason the owner is an incredible host and has a knack for creating delicious home style Texas BBQ! Check this place out, great drinks, great atmosphere, great food!

Great place. Very casual and comfortable. Prices and more than reasonable. Staff is amazing and just very down to earth all around. Just a very relaxing place by the water. Great drinks, food and environment... Can't ask for more!

We were starved and I suggested we hit china town to get some traditional chinese.  It was late so we went to the four corners of 10th and  race where they are all open till 3 am. If you are used to American chinese food meaning salty as hell beef and broccoli overdone general tso burnt fried rice then by all means this is the place for you. My mouth is still ringing as I write this yelp with the amounts of salt In each dish put in front of me. What happened to fresh vegetables and piled high plates of delicious steamed foods that we can all share. This was tiny plates of salt I know instead if thinking for the memories of the food I tried I will Instead be remember the bloat of water weight I will be carrying for the next ten days. Go home and cook

This is my favorite sandwich place they make it perfect. They make the food fresh as possible they are fast and it's pretty cheap I recommend this place if you feel like having a good sandwich and sort of in a hurry.

It's rare that my husband and I get a night out, due to not only coronavirus concerns but the fact that we have two kids under 8 at home! We were able to escape for dinner last night and wanted to try someplace new. We selected Tonic and it was a great selection! We started with a few appetizers, oysters for him, Brussels sprouts for me and we shared a cheese board. I had a delicious lemon drop martini (and then another!) and he started with an old-fashioned. The appetizers were great - correctly portioned and delicious! The Brussels sprouts had just enough oil and garlic. For dinner, I had crab cakes and my husband had steak and lobster tail. My crab cakes were perfect - not a lot of breading or filling and the side sauce was incredible. Loved the potatoes, too! Husband was in heaven, too! I also appreciate that I didn't wake up in the middle of the night dying for water because my dinner was too salty. The best part of our meal, though, was our server Alexandra. She was upbeat and paced everything well. She made our meal that much more enjoyable because she was so hospitable!
Visited this spot during Coolinary and was thoroughly impressed that the standard dinner service items were given as the Coolinary options. Great service, delicious food. Enjoyed!

decided to try the el rodeo in avon as i use to frequent the one in crawfordsville years ago. my mom & i wanted mexican food and called them up! they were easy to order with and answered questions. my mom got a shrimp burrito and loved it. i had steak cheese and rice. we also had a side of salsa & queso. the queso was sooo good. the chips were fresh and plentiful. the order was ready in 10mins like they said.

Not Covid safe. Not really trying. I love these guys and I've done pickup or delivery 1-2x per month since they started curbside back in May. But as I sit here waiting for my order, at the same time AZ has worst infection rate in the world, I've seen 6 people in the last 15 minutes come & go with no masks. People congregated by the host stand. 2 people standing at the host stand waiting for a table with no masks at all, well within arms reach of the host and carrying on a conversation with a 3rd person. A Door Dasher came in with no mask and hung around the bar waiting for an order with no mask. Really disappointing. Guess I'm done here for a while.

Came in tonight for the first time. Even though my husband and I live down the street, it was our first time visiting the restaurant. The food was amazing, I got a burger, the husband got a huge salad. We sat at the bar and were greeted immediately by Lauren. Throughout the night, she and another young girl behind the bar took amazing care of us, never missed a beat. Service was amazing, they were very attentive and answered all of our questions. They even made me a new favorite drink. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone i know.

It was our First time trying this restaurant. 
It's located in a strip mall so parking is convenient.

This Sushi Boss is not an ordinary restaurant where you get served by waiters. It's like Qdoba, Subway, Chipotle and etc.  When you walk into the restaurant, you place an order according to your preference.  I thought it was cool because I have never seen this type of business model applied to Japanese style of food. Food was prepared and made pretty fast. You get your food when you pay and you bring it to a table to eat. 

We had crunchy roll, omg roll and wicked spicy tuna roll. We picked off the menu instead of creating my own. They were all good and very filling. 

By checking In through Yelp app, I was able to get a free miso soup. Glad I was able to try it for free. Miso soup was a slight disappointment since it lacked flavor. 

Overall experience was good. I only get to try some rolls today but looking forward to try some poke bowls next time.
I absolutely love the taste of this pizza. The toppings are gourmet and the sauce is simple but flavorful. The fries are bangin too.

I went to Golf and Social for their Brunch and Boozy event. If you get there early you probably can find parking in the 7 Eleven parking lot. The venue is pretty nice. The drinks are yummy. I got the Emerald drink. The cost of the drinks start at $9.00. My drink was nice and strong. Also, its smart to make reservations. 

Food: I had the chicken and waffles ($12.00). The dish comes with 2 nice size wings and a waffle. When I asked the waitress how many pieces of chicken come with the waffles she told me 2, so in my head being greedy I thought 2 wings were not going to be enough, to my surprise they were. I was honestly full. The wings were seasoned perfectly. The waffles come with a nice white glaze sauce, not overly sweet. The service was good. Taylor was our waitress.  Nice young lady. The food came out in a reasonable amount of time. I was told by one of the servers its better to order food downstairs if you're on the rooftop. My friend got the shrimp and grits. She only got four medium size shrimp. She said that it was good. The homefries looked good as well. Nice side dish portion. 

Rooftop:
Since we had an early reservation (11:30am) we were able to go on the rooftop after our meal. The setting was pretty nice. There's an elevator that takes you to the top. So if you have on heels, you're good. 

I would definitely go back. I wouldn't go too late in the afternoon because it gets crowded after a certain time.

If you are looking for a chai beverage, go elsewhere! THere isn't even ANY tea in it. They use a chai flavored syrup and call it done. I couldn't stomach it. I went to Dutch Bros and told the order taker about it and he bought my beverage for me! The #2 star is for the Guru Donuts.

These guys still have got to have the best pizza in the area. In my humble opinion, the most important part of the pizza is the crust and sauce. The rest ofcourse is important as well, but when a place is able to get these right, the pizza is amazing. A number of friends have advised for me to try a few other places in the area, but Three Brothers still has my heart and pallette. One thing I would recommend is eatting at their location atleast the first time. The pizza is best on-site. We did a take out order a few times to share with family and friends, and though it was good, it wasn't the same as when it was fresh out of the oven. They've also got quite a delicious canoli should you have room after your meal.

I have dined in at Louie for an incredible experience and I have also done curbside delivery during these strange times. On both occasions, the food was incredible! I recommend both experiences. We got the parpadelle bolognese, roast chicken, and brussel sprouts. I wish I could have this for dinner every night.

I have finally found my favorite Chinese restaurant! This place has the best General Tsos Chicken!! Don't be fooled by the less than perfect building they are in because the food is fantastic! Also have great krab rangoons. Give it a try next time you drive by, you won't regret it!

Not the most wowing place but if you're in the area and is hungry for some food; it's a decent enough of a place. 

I ordered two Charlie's Special (comes with broccoli rabe and provolone cheese) - roast pork and chicken cutlet with a side of cajun fries.

Size wise was pretty good. The proteins, broccoli and cheese were pretty filled in the sandwich. I wasn't disappointed that. I was more disappointed with the lack of flavor in the sandwiches and the lack of customer service.

The sandwiches didn't have any distinct or strong flavor to me - almost forgettable. However, cajun fries was cooked perfectly and full of flavor. 

Customer service was not so great either. The taking order over the phone part was fine, however, when I went to pick up the order, the lady just handed me the food, took my card, gave me back the card and receipt to sign and she left... SHE JUST LEFT. 

Not a 'thank you', 'come again' or anything of that sort. Nothing was said beside her asking who what my name was for the order. It was such a weird experience, customer service was nonexistent and I didn't like that.

Personally, I'm not sure if I'll go back.

My family and I wanted to switch it up from fried chicken the other day, so we checked out the menu for smokin thighs. We ordered the baked beans, loaded potato salad, and smoked chicken nachos. Oh my goodness, the food is so good! The baked beans were super tasty, and the loaded potato salad was the best I've ever had! We couldn't get enough. The nachos were delicious too, with moist, flavorful chicken, and creamy queso on top! The only bummer was that they could have been much more generous with the toppings. Next time, I'll be sure to order extra. Servers and bartenders were super nice. I wish there was a 4.5 star option!  Can't wait to come here again.

I recently visited this beautiful restaurant and had a wonderful time!

Upon walking in, I immediately felt such great vibes as the music was playing, the drinks flowing and the smell of delicious food in the air. My friend and I sat at the bar waiting for an outside table, after just having our cocktails placed in front of us - our table was ready! Much shorter wait time than the quoted which I appreciated. 

Once outside on their beautiful, illuminated terrace, we were seated at a table that had been separated from the table behind us in an effort to socially-distance. Loved it. The menu has an option for everyone, and that's including the drinks! The guacamole was amazing!!! And I know guacamole! I went simple and got the quesadilla, as I had a big lunch, but next time I'll definitely try more!

Cheers to Besitos!
Wow! The burgers here were SO GOOD! And the sweet potato fries were just as amazing, if not better. I will definitely come back to get my burger fix!

Amazing experience and food to die for.

Huge shout out to Jarryd!!!! He was hilarious and made our night special.  Vince also did a fantastic job always making sure our glasses were full and explaining his favorites on the menu 

Must haves: turtle soup, pecan crusted red fish, and the bread pudding soufflé

Make sure to walk around the garden district about an hour before your reservation.

Music was ok. Crowded and drinks very pricey. At least they had a good amount of alcohol but their is plenty of other places around that mix their drinks just as strong for a better value. 

Apparently kid rock does perform randomly on a Saturday every now and again. (Heard it from our Uber driver)

Would I go back? Eh probably not. Went to acme last night and much better drinks and value.

My wife, daughter, and I went to the Salty Cowboy last night after a friend recommended it.  The meal was good, starting with a bowl of guacamole that was pricey at $13 but was HUGE.  It was made at the table with 3 avocados that were only partially smashed so it wasn't your typical smooth guac.  I had the Blazin' burrito; very good but a bit heavy on the rice.  The other two had tacos that they said were great.  

The food warrants 4 stars but I deducted one because of the BLACK LIVES MATTER sign right next to the entrance, which irritated me for the first 10 minutes or so after we sat down.  I don't support that organization and don't support businesses that endorse it, so I won't go back.  Had I been alone I'd have reversed course at the entrance but I didn't want to disappoint my wife and daughter---but now that I know, I'll take my dollars elsewhere from now on.    

Speaking of dollars, be sure to inspect your bill before you pay.  My $11 Blazin' rang up as $12, and when I questioned it I was told they'd increased the price in their system but hadn't printed new menus yet.  The waitress fixed it, but c'mon, any child would know that ain't the way to do it.

I really enjoy going here. I go almost once a week and I learned that building your own bowl is the best option for me. Normally I go during the week day and it is - superb! Filled and made exactly right ! The quality is not the same on the weekend. My bowl was half empty and considering you pay $11+ for it- it's definitely disappointing. However based on the fact that I normally go during the week and it's always fire - I'll just continue to go then and hope that the lady who makes our delicious bowls, never leaves !

Truly an experience for someone coming from down south! The sammies are GIANT! My husband and I split one for lunch and still had leftovers! Next time I would like to try a rueben, the Penn special kinda had too much sweet slaw for my tastes.
Always enjoy their food but have to say their efforts they have made to serve the public during this time of crisis has been amazing.  Thank you!

I ordered food everything was fine, until I found a hair in my food and the guy said "I can give you a discount" he gave me $5 off from a $21 bill, like I found a freaking hair on my food, I was disgusted, and I barely ate any of it. I was very disappointed, don't recommend eating here at all.

Tried to call in an order. The phone number goes directly to a full mailbox. Checked for the correct phone number on both Yelp and Google.
Edit: later, after we had already come in to purchase our food, the phone rang fine. Dunno

As much as I love the food as this hole in the wall restaurant, after my recent experience I will not return. My husband and I walked in and placed our orders I ordered 2 steak tacos add sour cream and a root beer and he got three plain taco just meat and cheese and a root beer. As the lady went to get the drinks she dropped the cup on the floor. Ok and not a simple drop she scraped it around on the floor for a minute or 2 trying to pick it up. Now I do not know if you have been in this place. It's old, all the seats are cracked, it's dirty, I would not eat something dropped off that floor. I certainly won't drink out of a cup that is scooping up who knows what behind that counter. My husband and I look at each other, the girl stands up and takes that dirt glass and starts to fill it with ice.  I'm like not eat. "Excuse me I know you are not expecting either one of us to drink out of a cup that rolled around on your floor?" She actually looked at me rolled her eyes, huffed slammed the cup down and got another. She got our drinks didn't even put the lids in and walked off. Needless to say our food order was wrong too and so soaked in grease it was pouring out of my husband's taco. If I could give a zero for the worse customer service exp of the year this would be it.

Food is fair to good, service is young and pleasant. This trip I had the mountain-high meatloaf with very thin/crispy onion rings, & mashed potatoes & gravy. The meatloaf was mostly bread, very soft, nearly tasteless. The rest was good. Comes with a better-than-average tossed salad (good house dressing) and dessert.
None of the entrees I have had were notably good, or bad, but this is a "tavern" with decent pub grub.

I told my husband I had never had Popeye's Chicken and he was surprised! He took me the next day (after telling me how great it is) and I was so disappointed . . .  I ordered the hot chicken tenders but they gave me the regular.   They were very dry, luke warm and had little flavor  The fries were just the same, no flavor, cold and very dry.  Oh well, at least I tried ~ won't be back . . .

I'll admit, I've been gravitating towards spending my Taco Tuesdays at places that definitely hype up the atmosphere and vibe over the food offerings. Nothing wrong with that though, as navigating life in the time of COVID-19 really does make you appreciate physical togetherness with people in public.

I digress! I chose to give El Guerrero a try for Tampa Bay Yelp's Virtual Cinco de Mayo/Taco Tuesday initiative. I admit that I know downtown and St. Pete eateries better than the ones down the block from my house so I am so glad that I was able to find El Guerrero through these circumstances.

The food I ordered included their popular California burrito, and two soft tacos--one shrimp and one steak. The food was definitely a great value for the portion and the flavors were fresh, straightforward, and satisfying. 

I liked how well-seasoned the steak was and their in-house salsa has a nice heat to it without being overbearing. The tortilla chips were also a generous portion and weren't too salty. 

I look forward to trying more of the menu (hopefully in person!) soon.
The keto fajita was amazing. The cauliflower rice tasted so good. I didn't think keto food tasted so good. The place was empty and so clean. You can eat inside or out and everyone wears a mask.
The food is great, and the staff is super friendly. This is one of my go to stops for breakfast or brunch.

Baileys' Chocolate Bar is always a good idea - especially when you want something sweet! I am so sad they are closed right now (thanks COVID) but it gives me something to look forward to when this is over. I highly recommend their chocolate martinis because the only thing better than a good drink is one made of chocolate.

The açaí bowls here are a bit overpriced but really good. If you're going to add peanut butter, I'd suggest telling them to scale it down a bit because they add too much and it completely takes away from the rest of the bowl.

I ordered take out from Minato last week and what I had was decent, but middle of the road. I cannot judge them too harshly, though, as I had to drive almost 30 minutes before I got to eat. 

I'm sticking to a low carb diet so I ordered the sashimi platter. It's a 12 piece platter of tuna, yellowtail and salmon. (They gave me and extra piece!) The yellowtail was very good! All the fish was fresh. 

My party also ordered the bulgogi donburi. Good, but order the extra meat! And 2 orders on tonkatsu ramen. Not as rich as big city ramens, but it'll do the trick if you're craving it. All of this was ready very quickly though so that's a big plus!

All in all I enjoyed my meal and would like to give them another try dine in.

I ordered a few items through the app from this Panera a few weeks earlier when the restaurants were still doing to-go orders only.  In the app, it offered curbside pick up. When I pulled up, there was 1 line of cars. Some of the people in line were placing and waiting for orders, and some of the people in line placed orders already on the app and are just picking up.  With the people who are placing the order in person, they are not parking to wait for their order after placing their orders.  So for those of us who already placed our orders, we had to wait in line with the rest of them. When I pulled up to pick up my order, it was not ready so I had to wait for it to be brought out. Not very organized as to the curbside pick up.

Stopped in for the first time tonight, I can't begin to give accolades for how delicious and plentiful the Moroccan chicken with tahini and a side order of roasted potatoes. Wonderful combination of flavors and Seasonings. And you know it's all healthy eatin'. 
I regret taking so long to try Hidden Grill, especially since I had read good reviews. I plan on going back quite often since it's only a mile or so away. I usually never write reviews, so in writing this it is for selfish reasons, but I want to see this place flourish and prosper. 
Trust me, don't go waste your money on a dinner from Whole Foods, Hidden Grill is cooking it up fresh for you on the spot. Give it a try!

This was the worst food I ever had . First of all the restaurant was so dirty(saw that after we sat down) and then the food was so cold and the pasta was not cool right, they also forgot to added extra protein on my pasta bowl so I had to go back and ask for more and for my surprise it was cold too. The staff were not friendly at all either. This was my first and last stop because I am not returning. I honestly make better pastas myself i just wanted to try something new but this has been the worst place ever . Please do not go there . The food doesn't even have flavor it was blend so blend.

**COVID19**

I would say this place is one of the best in PHILLY
I've tried a lot of different places and if you want something very simple ...I would recommend this place. If you want other stuff on it and make it fancy...then go to the one in Redding terminal cause I liked that place for my fancy cheese steak. 

Funny story but if you want to get subs here during COVID19, CALL BEFORE YOU GO!!!! I've seen so many people get mad and yelled and curse at the store as they storm into their car because they had to wait like 1 hour without making any calls

The food was delicious and were huge portions. I have gotten a lot of different things off of their menu. There is something for everyone and you can easily ask for extras or items to be taken off if you have picky kids. 5/5 we'll be back, probably in a couple of weeks!

With Covid shutting down buffets, Indian restaurants just aren't worth going to anymore. The cost of ordering entries and naan is easily triple what the buffet offered. And you can't come close to getting what you would have gotten at the buffet due to skimpy portions from Taj.  All the dishes we have ordered have been short on ingredients and consist mostly of sauce. What a shame. Back in the buffet day, Taj was the best. I don't know why they don't switch to cafeteria style service...
This place is so good, the 2nd best Cuban sandwich I have ever had, which is quite a feat. The guava and cheese pastry was amazing too!

Great unassuming traditional diner with a trendy vibe. Very good breakfast. Excellent coffee. 
A bit disappointing to see pork in so many of the menu items but the veggie sausage is delicious!
(Pigs are more intelligent than dogs and more closely related to humans than apes are. Stop eating them)

Did not eat here. Had a reservation, but we showed up 30 minutes early and was told they were "right on time".  Many open tables at the bar and in the restaurant (we have been servers and we do understand the ebb and flow of good restaurant service). Pretentious hostesses, not much care for our business by welcoming us in and making us feel like a valued customer. They were preoccupied with the business IN the establishment, not thinking of future business. Told to get a drink at the bar. Fine, no problem. No seats at the bar, no leaving one soon. We left and walked to a restaurant that gave us immediate, welcoming service. We spent $150 here, versus a restaurant that did not want our business.

4.5 stars - One stop shop for a variety of organic goods including produce, deli with smoothies, soups, hot and cold food, pay by weight grans/nuts/spices, supplements, vitamins, and so much more!  

KEY TAKEAWAYS - 

- SPICES, GRAINS, COFFEE, PEANUT BUTTER AND MORE BY WEIGHT - this may be the coolest feature of the store. 

I was making a soup the other day with spices that I don't use often and decided to buy the 4 spices needed from Rolling Oats using the pay by weight option. I spent under $1.30 for more than enough of each spice.  Such a win!  I typically buy full bottles of whatever spice is needed for my quarterly attempt at cooking, used them once or twice, and then into the trash they go, because they always expire before I can use them up. 

- DELI - some great options and so not so great options:

-- Great - green juices and smoothies (matcha energy buzz is amazing), soups (white chicken chili is delish), gf mac and cheese and rotisserie chicken are all wins. 
-- Not great - Everything I've had inside the glass case - from turkey Shepard's pie, to grilled salmon, to various salads and sides. All have been quite bland and underwhelming. 

- PRODUCE - All organic! 

- OVERALL - A great value for organic products with more affordable prices than Whole Foods or Fresh Market.

The Juicy Seafood is very tasty!  My daughter and I went while in Nashville and we were not disappointed.  They give you a bucket with utensils (gloves, bibs, crab crackers) and bring out your food in bags.  We really enjoyed The Butter and garlic seasoning.
The atmosphere is so romantic and the restaurant is beautiful! I ordered the trout and was highly impressed. The pricing is also extremely reasonable compared to other restaurants of this quality

Yes have no idea how this restaurant has good reviews. I went there for a takeout (due to COVID-19) I ordered beef shawarma, chicken shawarma, makdoos, lamb kabab with rise & fattush. Beef in the shawarma tasted funny (expired) I couldn't even swallow a bite from it. Chicken in the shawarma wasn't fresh cut, its been there for hours, maybe a day. The oil in the makdoos should be olive oil, I think they used cheap oil or something. Lamb kabab was overcooked (cant chew). Fattush doesn't taste like fattush at all. I am really disappointed. One thing I like is staff were good.
My favorite place in Indiana to eat breakfast or lunch. I would really recommend for anyone to eat at this place

Quite enjoyed my take out experience at El Dorado. I was hungry after taking fir baby to vet across street so ran in and ordered a fajita salad and ran back to car - fur baby still in car. 7 min later food ready - packed with utensils and chips and salsa and done.
Salsa was wonderful- thicker than most and wonderful flavor. 
People there were so nice and helpful. Glad I stopped. Would definitely go again. Parking easy peasy.

It was a cold night at the end of a long and arduous year, and COVID19 precautions had made dining out (literally, in little wooden sidewalk pod enclosures) less than completely appealing. But this lady was determined to still have a nice chef-prepared dinner for her wedding anniversary, and she was going to trek out by bus and trudge through icy air to get it.

Italian pasta was the plan, and after much searching on Yelp (whereby I discovered many COVID19-related closures), I finally found Bistro La Baia. With promising reviews, we decided to try this option on the outskirts of Rittenhouse Square. Lobster ravioli for me, and penne arrabiata for the significant other. The food was ready right on time when I arrived, and came with a complimentary bundled of delicious slices of Italian bread that practically crackles when bitten into.

The entrees were quite good as well. The ravioli consisted of six pieces, two sauteed shrimp and a rich, creamy tomato sauce. That and half a piece of the Italian bread made for a perfectly portioned and delicious meal for me. The penne arrabiata was a larger portion, and while not the best ever, it still met with the S.O.'s overall approval.

The sidewalk seating wooden pods were empty when I arrived, but that was before 6PM, so maybe the restaurant was busier later in the evening. Under new ownership 10/2020. You know all too well how a company could have a great product but the customer service leaves much to be desired.  That's been the reputation of the Springfield Primo Hoagie store.

Fret no more.  It was pure coincidence that today was the day to give this place one more chance and I made an online order.   Whal-la Dave the new 5 day owner and I made acquaintance.   He says he aims to please and is very excited about his new venture and meeting the community.  

Give Primo/Springfield another chance.  

I highly recommend Dave at Primo Hoagies in our own backyard.

Delicious Greek food!!!!  Made my own bowl with all the great options and it came out delicious..  Customer service was wonderful as we were greeted and assistance was offered right away as to explain what everything was and how they were prepared.  She even told me about a spicy aioli sauce that wasn't on the menu that I might like and it totally enhanced the bowl and also great with the fries.  The dolmades was  light and baklava was tasty and not too dense.  Loved this place.

Some of the best gumbo I've ever eaten, and I've had my fill. I also never really like deviled eggs but gave Atchafalaya's a chance... and am pleased with that decision. For my main course, i got rainbow trout. That too was excellent. And if you're feeling adventurous at brunch, try one (or several, if you're not driving) of the bywaters. Unlike any drink I've had before--somewhere between a kale smoothie and a classic bloody mary.

Rustic-chic eatery that looks a little like the inside of a boat, and has both regular and raw bars.

Offer classic seafood dishes such as seafood boil's, po' boys, and seafood towers. Get their seafood flown in from the East Coast.

Complimentary valet

I went for lunch with my cousin and ordered a "Pacemaker" (oyster) po'boy. It came with homemade chips, but I substituted in fries for an additional charge. Everything that I had was delicious (especially the bread and the fries) except for the actual oysters, which were fair. The oysters were ok, but they were just very small and most of the substance of the sandwich was just pieces of fried dough. My cousin got the shrimp po'boy and said it was very good also. She also got the chips that came with it, and they were delicious also.
They use to be good. I asked if they have recently been sold. They ready my question and never answered me. Very rude so that answers my question.   New food not as good. Better places around.
Best French toast I've ever had in my life, prompt service, not a touristy breakfast spot which is why we love it!

So I came to this spot spontaneously (such a me thing to do) and honestly this has got to be one of the best steaks I've ever had! Very juicy and cooked well done (it was medium rare)! Who ever cooked it did an amazing job. Quality was 5/5

Now for service, I had Drew. Very informative and knows his stuff. Highly recommend him as a server! Does not bother you every two seconds (it gets irritating for people who want to be left alone) but also knows when to come to you when needed immediately. Can someone give this man a raise? 

Thank you for the great service! I'll be returning soon with my friends and hopefully can get the same server ^^

Could use more flavor in their curry and pad thai.. and more friendly service. Felt like a "meh" atmosphere to me. I wouldn't call it authentic, it only seems suitable to come here for the Thai tea or Vietnamese coffee ice creams. Unique desserts but not a Thai food competitor to me

Don't eat here. Just don't. I know it's hard to get good seafood in Boise but you're better off getting something from Costco and warming it up yourself. I knew the food was not going to satisfy me but i was indulging a friend. Our waitress got pretty standoffish (haha) when we sent the "crab stuffed" mushrooms back for the second time. They came to us barely warm the first time and a tiny bit warmer after we asked for them to warm them up again... not that they were even worth the purchase. It was like getting a TGI Friday's frozen version of wannabe seafood appetizers. We were trying to be nice about it and just kindly asked that she take them back and ask them to maybe put some more cheese on them and heat those babies up. Maybe the waitress just assumed we were "those" kind of people after that but we didn't see much of her and certainly didn't get the friendly waitress treatment we previously had. That's what makes me really upset. I don't like getting poor service when I eat out. I was a waitress for 5 years and I know it all. We left her a $10 tip on an $80 tab. That was way too much for food and service combined. Left even more disappointed than I thought I would.

New Yorker here - have had Sicilian pies many places around Tampa and this is by far the best tasting; great crust and great sauce.  Friendly staff, great customer service in addition makes this the best pizza in the Tampa area.

Food is ok, but don't ever use a Gift Card from there.
Never ever buy a gift card from there unless you are going to use it all at once.  
Very disappointed in the wait staff that rang up too much money on the gift card, but presented me with a bill stating I had credit.  When I tried to use credit, the gift card was nearly empty.  Shame on them.  They just committed fraud!  

The owner found the problem and gave us a $30.00 gift card.  Don't be afraid to say something.  People make mistakes.
